def test_is_simple_power():

    assert is_simple_power(1, 1)
    assert not is_simple_power(2, 1)
    assert not is_simple_power(0, 1)

    # x == 1 is n^0 for any n != 1
    assert is_simple_power(1, 2)
    assert is_simple_power(1, 3)
    assert is_simple_power(1, 10)

    # exact powers
    assert is_simple_power(2, 2)

    assert is_simple_power(16, 2)
    assert is_simple_power(27, 3)

    assert is_simple_power(25, 5)
    assert is_simple_power(125, 5)
    assert is_simple_power(100, 10)

    # non-powers
